verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts (a folder with SKILL.md) that you own, and you can host your own plugin marketplace from local paths or git repos. Agent Skills is published as an open standard that works across multiple AI tools, and a community developer adapted the repo into a model-agnostic version running on Gemini. However, the runtime that executes skills is Claude Code or the Claude API, where API skills run in Anthropic's code-execution container, so no first-party fully self-hosted stack is documented. Missing for 10: a first-party self-hostable runtime or execution environment independent of Anthropic's hosted model, documented air-gapped or on-prem deployment guidance, and broader independent corroboration of fully self-hosted use.
